title: Golden State Baptist College
description: About Golden State Baptist College Golden State Baptist College, a ministry of North Valley Baptist Church in Santa Clara, California, offers a range of academic programs including majors and a master's program. Golden State Baptist College fell victim to a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of more than 422 GB of confidential data. The stolen data includes documents containing correspondence with clients, financial information, personal data of employees and clients, as well as other important information about the company.
